description: An expanded type constructor argument is read as the argument itself
notes: The README's type constructors take a type expression as their argument, and the native syntax spec only lets an expanded argument be a list or tuple value, which a type keyword isn't. hashicorp/hcl reads the call with hcl.ExprCall, whose result has no field for the expansion (native/analysis/call-expanded-final-argument), so getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) reads string as the element type.
